notes.title: Demo update!
notes.content:
[h3]The demo has been updated![/h3][p]This update introduces new gameplay features and visual improvements to enhance your experience.[/p][p]
[b]List of changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Weak points can now be hit without scanning first, but require greater precision. Their positions are also slightly randomized at the start of battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Shooting now has recoil.[/p][/*][*][p]Status effect activations are now more visually noticeable.[/p][/*][*][p]Combatant sprites now display Bleed, Stun, Sleep, and Darkness effects during battle.[/p][/*][*][p]A new slowdown effect plays when successfully dodging an attack.[/p][/*][*][p]The Knife command is now highlighted during enemy revenge sequences.[/p][/*][*][p]A new animation plays when picking up key items.[/p][/*][*][p]Smoke Bombs are now available for purchase, allowing you to escape from any non-story battles.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Weak points can now be hit without scanning first, but require greater precision. Their positions are also slightly randomized at the start of battle.
Status effect activations are now more visually noticeable.
Combatant sprites now display Bleed, Stun, Sleep, and Darkness effects during battle.
A new slowdown effect plays when successfully dodging an attack.
The Knife command is now highlighted during enemy revenge sequences.
A new animation plays when picking up key items.
Smoke Bombs are now available for purchase, allowing you to escape from any non-story battles.
